tha-ap455:1.1: Sīhāsanavījanīya.] Tissassāhaṃ bhagavato bodhirukkham a*vandi 'haṃ* / paggayha vījaniṃ tattha sīhāsanam avīj' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap455:2.1: Dvenavute ito kappe sīhāsanam avīj' ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi vījanāya idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap455:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Sīhāsanavījanīyo th. i. g. a-ti.
